description: External Claude Code skills/plugins to install. These are NOT stored in the repo; only tracked here so setup is reproducible.

plugins.name: obsidian-skills
plugins.description: Obsidian Flavored Markdown, Bases, JSON Canvas, CLI, and Defuddle skills by Steph Ango (Obsidian CEO)

plugins.name: argos-cli
plugins.description: Operate the Argos visual regression CLI (official skill from argos-ci)
plugins.install: npx skills add argos-ci/argos-javascript -g -a claude-code -s argos-cli -y

plugins.name: argos-pr-review
plugins.description: Review Argos visual regression builds on PRs (official skill from argos-ci)
plugins.install: npx skills add argos-ci/argos-javascript -g -a claude-code -s argos-pr-review -y

plugins.name: improve-codebase-architecture
plugins.description: Find architecture deepening opportunities using project domain language and ADRs (Matt Pocock)
plugins.install: npx skills add mattpocock/skills -g -a claude-code -s improve-codebase-architecture -y

plugins.name: setup-matt-pocock-skills
plugins.description: Bootstrap per-repo issue-tracker config for to-prd / to-issues / triage / etc. (Matt Pocock). Note: only knows GitHub + local-md natively; we override with Linear MCP via the Agent Skills block in CLAUDE.md.
plugins.install: npx skills add mattpocock/skills -g -a claude-code -s setup-matt-pocock-skills -y

plugins.name: grill-with-docs
plugins.description: Stress-test plans aligned with codebase docs and ADRs (Matt Pocock)
plugins.install: npx skills add mattpocock/skills -g -a claude-code -s grill-with-docs -y

plugins.name: to-prd
plugins.description: Turn resolved context into a PRD (Matt Pocock)
plugins.install: npx skills add mattpocock/skills -g -a claude-code -s to-prd -y

plugins.name: to-issues
plugins.description: Convert PRDs into vertical-slice GitHub issues (Matt Pocock)
plugins.install: npx skills add mattpocock/skills -g -a claude-code -s to-issues -y

plugins.name: tdd
plugins.description: Implement features using red-green-refactor for agentic coding (Matt Pocock)
plugins.install: npx skills add mattpocock/skills -g -a claude-code -s tdd -y

plugins.name: triage
plugins.description: Organize GitHub issues; transform backlog ideas into actionable tasks (Matt Pocock)
plugins.install: npx skills add mattpocock/skills -g -a claude-code -s triage -y
